title: A narrative template’s free text holds no figure
assertion: Every figure `scanText` reads in strict mode (digit runs, signs, Roman numerals after a level, ordinal days, every word of the scanner’s tables, “zero”, “thousands”, “paid nothing”) fails at its span (`free_figure`, `number_word`), from a person or a model, while markers (a person’s), identifier placeholders (a person’s) and fact tokens pass. A fact token with a sign, a point, a letter, a digit or another token typed against it, or with a sign, a currency sign or a sign’s word (“negative”, “minus”) set off before it by whitespace, brackets or quotation marks, fails at its span (`fact_not_separated`), and a numeral character normalization reads as letters (“Ⅻ”) is a `free_figure`. A model’s draft with any `/3` mismatch is not written (`not_drafted`, `misstated`); a text segment with `{`, `}`, `[` or `]` is `invalid_output`; a model’s `line.*`/`claim.*` id is `unknown_fact`. The pre-call guard passes a synthetic surname equal to a vocabulary word.
noFileReason: Templates verified over the generated and the named SYNTHETIC fact packets of the packets tests: no file.
notes: Pending, slice 6 (the gateway prompt and schema): a model’s draft with a /3 mismatch not written (not_drafted, misstated), a text segment with a brace or a bracket as invalid_output, a model’s line.* or claim.* id as unknown_fact, and the pre-call guard. The tests listed assert the verifier’s and serializeDraft’s half.
